name: Draftling
summary: Distraction-free writerdeck: edit Markdown on Sticky with any Bluetooth keyboard and sync with Git.
description: Draftling turns Sticky into a minimalist writerdeck. Pair any Bluetooth Low Energy keyboard and edit Markdown, Fountain screenplays, or plain text files stored on the microSD card, with styled WYSIWYG rendering and split-screen editing. A built-in Git client can sync your files over Wi-Fi with GitHub or any smart-HTTP Git server.

compatibility.notes: Version 1.0.16 is tested on reTerminal Sticky production hardware. Requires a Bluetooth Low Energy keyboard and a microSD card. SD card via USB is not available on this board.

assets.previewAlt: Draftling editing a Markdown file on reTerminal Sticky with a Bluetooth keyboard

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: Installation
notes.description: The package writes the bootloader, partition table, OTA data, and Draftling application. It uses a dual-OTA partition layout, so the device can move between Draftling and other Sticky firmware without extra steps.

notes.title: Storage and keyboard
notes.description: Insert a microSD card for your documents. Press F1 on a paired Bluetooth keyboard to open the menu; holding the Power button for 2 seconds forgets all stored keyboards.
